# UK Law RAG

A retrieval-augmented question-answering system for navigating UK administrative and legal rules — visas, tax, housing, banking, employment rights, the NHS, and education — grounded entirely in [gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk) and [nhs.uk](https://www.nhs.uk) content.

Six retrieval strategies, benchmarked and compared, with a Corrective RAG (CRAG) pipeline that grades its own retrieval and can decline to answer rather than guess.

Full documentation, architecture, and the engineering log live in the GitHub repo: **[github.com/Harshkawade007/UK-LAW-RAG](https://github.com/Harshkawade007/UK-LAW-RAG)**. This Space is a mirror kept in sync automatically on every push to `main` — edits belong in GitHub, not here.
